method: Full-frame 60fps foreground-pixel mask and polygon-contour tracing from uploaded game footage, not original game engine wall spawn/physics commands.
limitations: Color-based contours approximate video silhouettes, with simplification and mask errors during sudden colors/morphs.
Original wall spawn times/speeds/thickness/actor identities have not been independently recovered from source game engine.
Camera and center-ship speed/motion not fully source-measured; per-frame replay shows video silhouettes rather than independent wall events.

Visual frame matching and long-duration survivability have not been exhaustively certified.
notes: Geometry sampled at actual 60fps. Source 1595: 5379 frames (0..93.37 game s). Source 1596: 5718 frames (0..99.25 game s).
Core contour transient 7/8-sided misclassification corrected to closest following valid 4-6 sides; not exact engine shape transition reconstruction.
